name: Kuroda Kanbee
source:
Hobby: Saving Things

Believing that his words are clear enough as long as the recipients have no questions, he seldom explains anything when delivering messages. He frowns slightly whenever he feels shy.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/ikusa.html]English official site[/url]]
